input.title: Studio Assistant
input.description: About Comfrt: Comfrt is one of the fastest-growing direct-to-consumer brands, dedicated to blending mental wellness, inclusivity, and elevated comfort into every piece we create. Our mission goes beyond clothing — we strive to build a community where everyone feels supported and seen. Role Overview: We are looking for a highly organized and detail-oriented Studio Assistant to support the day-to day operations of Comfrt's Miami studio. You will be the backbone of our production environment, keeping samples organized, garments shoot-ready, and the studio running smoothly. This is a hands-on, on-site role that plays a critical part in ensuring our content days and shoots go off without a hitch. Key Responsibilities: Organize, catalog, and maintain inventory of all samples and production garments Keep racks, shelves, and storage areas tidy, labeled, and logically organized at all times. Track all sample movement in and out of the studio for shoots, fittings, loans, and returns, ensuring accurate records are maintained. Perform quality control checks on garments prior to shoots, reviewing fit, construction, and cleanliness. Steam, tag, and prep all garments for content days and shoot days. Assist during fittings, shoots, and studio visits, including set-up, teardown, and on-set support throughout the day. Maintain overall studio cleanliness, including sweeping, tidying common areas, and managing supply levels. Proactively identify workflow improvements and stay ahead of studio needs before they become issues. Support miscellaneous errands, returns, and supply pickups as needed. Requirements: 2+ years of hands-on experience working in production or studio environments , with proven experience supporting and prepping for photoshoots . Strong organizational and project management skills , with the ability to manage high-volume production workflows, timelines, and multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment. Experience with e-commerce, fashion, or apparel photography/production strongly preferred , with a professional understanding of studio and shoot processes. Exceptional organizational skills and a strong attention to detail. Experience with garment steaming, care, and quality inspection. Familiarity with sample tracking systems or inventory management tools. An eye for visual organization and brand presentation. Ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously in a fast-paced environment without losing accuracy. A proactive, low-ego attitude. You take initiative, no task is too small, and you take pride in keeping things running smoothly. Strong communication skills and comfort working closely with a small, collaborative team. Physically able to stand for extended periods, lift garment racks, and handle the physical demands of an active studio environment. Based in Miami, FL . This role requires full-time, on-site presence. Must have own means of transportation Why Join Comfrt? Be part of a purpose-driven company that’s shaping the future of comfort and mental wellness. Work in a supportive, creative environment where your ideas and growth are valued. Enjoy Comfrt benefits such as generous paid time off, company-covered health insurance, 5% 401k match, and discounts on all Comfrt products! Comfrt is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills.

input.title: Assistant Store Manager (full-time) - Programming and Special Events
input.description: What is the Role? We are seeking a Full-time Assistant Store Manager - Responsible for Programming and Special Events, to join our Miami team. You will be responsible for guiding CAMP’s families through our retail experience, ensuring they have a magical experience and want to return! This includes: SELLING FLOOR Support the General Manager in managing the day-to-day operations of the store to ensure the store and teams meet KPI targets Collaborate with General Manager to develop clear action plans for the store and team and strive to achieve objectives, deliverables, and timelines for each plan Act as a results-driven role model for the team to impact sales generation and exceptional customer service Lead and support the oversight of the Canteen floor; acting as Manager on Duty to ensure all operational and customer-facing needs are met Monitor and coach staff to continually improve selling opportunities and build genuine customer relationships Create and implement visual and merchandising strategies to increase sales. Utilizes selling reports to understand floor capacity, layout, and sell through opportunities Support the General Manager and leadership team with goal achievement (KPIs) Motivate and inspire the team to achieve/exceed hourly, daily, weekly business goals through in-store selling, using strong business acumen skills Create and maintain a positive and productive work environment that fosters diversity, inclusivity, teamwork, creativity and a passion for the Camp brand Partner with the General Manager to identify and assess training needs. Create tailored training plans to implement various training methods to enhance team members skills and performance Assist in managing labor spend to optimize responsible spending and profit opportunities Other duties as assigned PROGRAMMING/CELEBRATIONS Lead the planning and execution for all programming, special events and celebrations that take place in the store Ensure schedule is written to leverage all in-store programming events (Meet & Greets, Slime Bootcamps, Birthday Parties, etc) Communicate all upcoming special events to store to team to maximize increase in customer traffic and business opportunities Consistently works to optimize revenue potential by identifying programming opportunities during peak and non-peak times. Partner with Director of Programming to optimize performance Engage with all incoming birthday party leads. Actively sell/upsell birthday parties to achieve selling targets. Partner with Celebrations and Events Sales Coordinator to optimize performance Ensure available time slots are up to date to maximize events and party booking opportunities Manage and coach team performance to ensure customer experience and reviews are positively impacted Ensure all programming related supplies are fully stocked. If necessary, place supply orders to ensure proper inventory levels What are the physical demands? Ability to stock merchandise from store receiving to shelving; ability to place product, weighing up to 45 pounds, on shelving at various heights (may be climbing up and down a ladder) Exposure to outdoor elements such as sun, precipitation, and wind Regularly required to sit, stand, bend, reach, push, pull, lift, carry and walk about the store Ability to safely operate manual and electrical equipment from time to time Able to be on your feet for up to 8 hours per shift and to continuously move around all areas of the store Kneeling and squatting from time to time when engaging children or stocking / restocking shelves Compensation: $24.00/hr What is required? Ability to work at least one weekend day/week, but ideally both! Open availability. This role is full-time, and you will be working approximately 40 hours / each week Strong organization skills with a keen attention to detail Demonstrated ability to lead and motivate a team to achieve goals Prior work experience in any of the following areas: retail, child-care, child development/ education, performing arts. Excellence, enthusiasm, and excitement around engaging with children and families creatively. Desire to be part of a tight-knit team looking to transform the traditional retail experience. Patience, warmth, joy, and humor. Bonus but not required: you may have hidden talents that can add magical moments to our retail experience. Must be 18 years of age or older Must be authorized to work in the United States We provide our team with the following perks: Medical Coverage & Pharmacy Benefits including virtual doctor visits Dental & Vision Coverage Gym and Wellness Discounts Voluntary Pet Insurance Health Care Flexible Spending Account (FSA) Dependent Care Flexible Spending Account (FSA) Life & AD&D Insurance Long Term Disability Mass Transit & Commuter Parking Programs Benefits Concierge: a team of dedicated and experienced employee benefits advocates who are ready to help you and your family with questions Employee Assistance Program: offers support around Education, Legal and Financial Planning, Career Development, Lifestyle and Fitness Management, Mental Health, and Dependent Care 20% off all merchandise at CAMP’s retail stores and CAMP.com PTO 401(k) Plan(Employee contribution only) 1.5 pay on the following holidays: Independence Day, Labor Day, New Years Day, Martin Luther King Day, Memorial Day, Juneteenth

input.title: Manager, Programming Publicity
input.description: The Manager, Programming Publicity will be responsible for generating maximum, positive media for Telemundo’s entertainment programming, with a focus on daytime, scripted and unscripted shows. The role reports to the SVP, Publicity and Communications. Responsibilities Development and execution of comprehensive plans for external publicity (consumer media and social influencers) generating maximum amount of positive coverage for key programming premieres, priorities and other entertainment-related projects for daytime, scripted and unscripted entertainment programming. Demonstrate strong writing skills, in English and Spanish, to create consumer press materials including press releases, media alerts, pitch letters, talent bios, as well as coordinate and manage pr activities such as press junkets, media interviews, on-set visits, photo shoots, EPK’s and press kits. Cultivate and maintain strong relationships with key journalists and media outlets with a focus on top-tier consumer outlets to reach core and new Telemundo viewers and other relevant audiences. Ensure digital publicity efforts are a key part of all campaigns and create targeted strategies for social media influencers/content creators to expand promotional campaigns in the social media space and other non-traditional media outlets and identify appropriate influencers per campaign. Develop strategic partnerships with digital creators, influencers, podcasters and emerging content platforms to expand audience reach and drive cultural relevance for key programming initiatives. Utilize AI-powered communications, media monitoring, audience intelligence and content creation tools to enhance publicity planning, identify trends, optimize workflows and support strategic decision-making while adhering to company guidelines and best practices. Monitor and analyze campaign performance, media sentiment, audience engagement and competitive trends using traditional and AI-enabled analytics platforms, providing actionable insights and recommendations to leadership. Identify and implement innovative publicity approaches, technologies and industry best practices to enhance campaign effectiveness, efficiency and audience engagement. Collaborate closely with marketing, digital marketing, cross-promotions and programming teams to create cohesive and consistent promotional plans across functions and platforms. Prepare talent and company executives for media interviews, press events and speaking opportunities. Partner with corporate and internal comms counterparts to support, position and convert campaigns into full 360 plans across all communications areas. Collaborate with PR agencies to drive story creation and favorable coverage. Service daily media requests and act as network source of information for assigned programming publicity properties. Monitor competitive environment via daily review of competitive/industry news, and interface with other departments and NBCUniversal channels on an as needed basis. Works under the direct supervision of SVP, Publicity and Communications and is responsible for completing any other tasks as assigned by supervisor. Basic Qualifications Bachelor's Degree in Public Relations or related field. Minimum 5 years of publicity/communications experience. Demonstrated ability for writing press materials in both English and Spanish. Ability to produce thorough reports and executive summaries detailing the results of strategic efforts for publicity campaigns as well as evaluating campaign performance to inform communications strategies. Familiarity with generative AI platforms and AI-powered communications, research, monitoring and productivity tools, with the ability to leverage emerging technologies responsibly and effectively. Deep understanding of the U.S. Hispanic media landscape, audience behaviors, digital consumption trends and social media best practices. Knowledge and hands-on use of Digital and Social Media platforms. Highly organized and able to manage/prioritize multiple projects. Must be fully fluent in Spanish and English. Experience working for or with PR agencies. Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications (Word, Excel, PowerPoint and related collaboration tools) and familiarity with communications, media monitoring and project management platforms. Eligibility Requirements Willingness to work flexible hours including early mornings, late and/or last-minute scheduling changes in a 24/7 production work environment. Willingness to travel with short notice and on weekends. Must be willing to work in the greater Miami, Florida area. Must be 18 years or older. Must have a valid driver’s license. Must have unrestricted work authorization to work in the United States. Must be covered by Solutions, NBCU’s Alternative Dispute Resolution Program. Interested candidate must submit a resume/CV through www.nbcunicareers.com to be considered. Desired Characteristics Experience working with entertainment/consumer media, with emphasis on US Hispanic media Thorough understanding of digital publicity activities and measurement. Comfortable navigating a rapidly evolving media landscape and identifying opportunities across traditional, digital and creator-led platforms. Proven skills in launching shows, crisis management and interfacing with all levels of executives, talent and media. Strategic, analytical and creative skill set. Demonstrated curiosity and enthusiasm for emerging technologies, including AI-powered communications tools, audience intelligence platforms and innovative approaches to media engagement. Strong analytical mindset with the ability to translate data, audience insights and performance metrics into effective publicity strategies and actionable recommendations. Previous journalism background desired but not required. Excellent written, verbal, communications and presentation skills. Highly organized self-starter able to work both independently and with a team. Proven ability to multi-task and meet numerous deadlines in a fast-paced, collaborative environment. Additional Requirements This position currently has a hybrid schedule, which requires contributing from the office a minimum of four days per week. input.title: Sports Line Producer
input.description: The Line Producer is responsible for the successful coordination, execution, and timing of live and taped sports programming. The Line Producer oversees preparation and editorial content for broadcast, manages all aspects of the production cycle, field produces as needed, and coordinates with internal support areas. This role supports sports productions across multiple platforms such as; MLB, NFL, NBA, soccer (Mexican, LATAM, International, and U.S. domestic), and other major sports properties relevant to the U.S. Hispanic market. QUALIFICATIONS Meet with Managers to review production schedules and editorial content for upcoming MLB, NFL, NBA, soccer, and other sports linear and non-linear deliverables. Coordinate production and staffing needs for broadcasts, including editing, control room operations, technical production, and art departments. Coordinate with the Digital Production team on the creation and delivery of content pieces and assets, as well as promotional and marketing elements related to assigned sports properties. Review, provide feedback, and/or approve marketing, promotional, and PR/communications materials related to sports productions. Verify sponsored elements and traffic instructions leading up to broadcasts. Coordinate with the Production Manager to ensure all production elements are built and ready for air. Prepare original editorial content for live events, studio shows, and digital extensions, including selecting sound bites and footage to build multi-platform, multi-purpose content. Write and supervise scripts, as well as oversee the editing of stories and game-related content. Meet with show directors, control room crews, and production staff to review show details, production assignments, rundowns, and editorial direction. Meet with on-air talent to review editorial aspects, game coverage, and show flow. Field produce stories and live remote productions, including  MLB, NFL, and NBA events , as assigned. Maintain complete knowledge of all show elements and understand how they are applied across various sports productions and platforms. Provide story ideas and recommendations to enhance content for linear, digital, and social platforms. Research stories and produce sweeps or special sports series as needed. Prepare scripts and materials for cross-promotional purposes and for use by the Digital Media department and network affiliates. Manage a team of Associate Producers and Production Assistants by assigning tasks, supervising performance, and ensuring timely completion of deliverables. Must be in the PCR as the executive producer with ultimate creative and managerial authority over a live sports studio show, responsible for shaping the narrative, tone, and production quality. Basic Requirements: Minimum 5 years of experience producing entertainment or sports television programming 5+ years of Control Room experience, including line producing live and taped programs 6+ years of progressively complex live remote or related production experience Fluent bilingual English/Spanish (written and verbal) Bachelor’s degree in Journalism, Communications, Broadcasting, Radio/TV/Film, or equivalent experience Strong working knowledge of INEWS, MS Office, Avid Interplay, and related production tools Solid editing, writing, and production fundamentals Familiarity with production and post-production equipment, software, and formats Ability to line produce and direct a control room technical crew Knowledge of sports content, with emphasis on Mexican & International soccer, U.S. domestic sports, and the U.S. Hispanic market Availability to work a non‑traditional schedule (nights, weekends, holidays, overtime) Desired Characteristics Strong problem‑solving and decision‑making abilities, particularly in live production environments Excellent written and verbal communication skills; able to coordinate across multiple departments Ability to perform effectively in a fast‑paced, high‑pressure environment with shifting priorities Highly organized, detail‑oriented, and capable of managing multiple projects simultaneously Creative and innovative thinker with a strong editorial sensibility Social‑media savvy, with an understanding of multi‑platform content distribution Strong collaboration skills with internal and external partners Demonstrated ability to adapt to last‑minute changes and meet tight deadlines Professional, dependable, and able to represent the department and company with integrity and ethics Ability to work independently with minimal supervision while maintaining accountability Strong teamwork skills and ability to follow direction from multiple stakeholders Ability to communicate clearly and calmly in fast‑paced or stressful situations Additional Requirements: Hybrid : This position currently has a hybrid schedule, which requires contributing from the office a minimum of four days per week.
